versions.text: Each fuel tank filler connection must prevent the entrance of fuel into any part of the aeroplane other than the tank itself. In addition – (a) Reserved (b) Each recessed filler connection that can retain any appreciable quantity of fuel must have a drain that discharges clear of each part of the aeroplane; (c) Each filler cap must provide a fuel-tight seal; and (d) Each fuel filling point must have a provision for electrically bonding the aeroplane to ground fuelling equipment.
